elements.label: About
elements.value: Character friction combined with ground surface friction to determine sliding and stopping behavior.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/friction.schema.json, set fr_c_mode to {{fr_c_mode}}]
Set KinematicForceController.frictionCombineMode to {{fr_c_mode}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/friction.schema.json, set fr_t_static to {{fr_t_static}}]
Set KinematicForceController.staticFriction to {{fr_t_static}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/friction.schema.json, set fr_t_dynamic to {{fr_t_dynamic}}]
Set KinematicForceController.dynamicFriction to {{fr_t_dynamic}}.
